title: Taylor: next rocket-science advance will come from religion
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Taylor: next rocket-science advance will come from religion, about 2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: When Diana Pasulka asked Taylor why he was interested in her work on religious studies, his answer was simple, "The next development in my field, rocket science, will come from yours, religion."

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels retells a moment from American Cosmic, a book by Diana Pasulka, a scholar of religion. According to that account, when Pasulka asked Timothy Taylor, a NASA mission controller, in the 2010s why he cared about her research on religion, he said the next big advance in his field, rocket science, would come from hers. The story suggests that some space insiders believe religious experience holds clues about the UFO question.
